posts.text:
Verstappen wins his first Singapore Grand Prix on his 250th Grand Prix start, completing a weekend of two poles and two wins. Leclerc and Antonelli complete the podium; Norris and Piastri round out the top five.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=singapore-grand-prix-verstappen-win

Hamilton slips from third to sixth as his soft tyres fade in Singapore. Piastri recovers from an extra stop for a puncture and passes him at Turn 16 on the final lap for fifth.
